title: Relay setup writes worktrees = ".worktrees" and ignores…
what: lib/relay_setup.py:195: MEDIUM: F7 relay setup writes worktrees = ".worktrees" and ignores .worktrees/ whatever the project's bin/wt makes
why: 29 Oct, design review of the ALIX worktree-folder fix: outside that change. ALIX's bin/wt makes .worktree/; relay setup would write and ignore the wrong folder there. IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen).
failing_case: relay setup on ALIX (bin/wt makes .worktree/<name>): kit.toml gets worktrees = ".worktrees" and .gitignore gets
.worktrees/, while gate.wt = "bin/wt" keeps making .worktree/. Every reader of project.worktrees (openspec skills,
the guard advice) then points at a folder the project never uses. Expected: worktrees = ".worktree".
pass_cases: 1. Project whose bin/wt or registered worktrees use .worktree/: setup writes worktrees = ".worktree".
2. Project with no bin/wt and no worktrees: setup writes ".worktrees" as today.
